Changes in office environment became evident first, quickly followed by improved business metrics and an increase in patient visits from old and new referral sources. 

Under Meghna's guidance the clinic grew while becoming more organized in every aspect of day to day operation. Meghna took every opportunity to learn from her colleagues and other leaders and continued to improve her skills as a manager and a clinician. A fair and compassionate manager, it was obvious she took pride in mentoring her staff to maximize the team's potential and their individual success. Being in almost daily contact with her, I remember her frequent enthusiasm to ‘brainstorm’ about a new idea she had for marketing, new programs, or how to improve existing processes. She is passionate about problem solving at all levels. In fact, I continue to use many of her ideas and improvements she introduced while working at NovaCare.

She is very goal-oriented and is not afraid to make difficult decisions in the short term, in order to pursue long term goals and success. I strongly believe that Meghna will be a great asset to any team and I am honored to recommend her for even the most demanding positions.

headline: Finance Professional | Audit & FP&A Background | Financial Reporting, Analysis & Planning
about:
Hi, I'm Lukas, a finance professional born in Austria and currently living in Chicago. I’m a finance professional with 5 years of experience in audit and financial analysis, working at the intersection of financial reporting, planning, and data-driven insights.

My background is in statutory and group audits under Austrian GAAP as well as cross-border engagements under US GAAP, combined with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, KPI reporting, and management decision support. about:
After 20+ years in journalism, I have ink in my blood, but it's my passion for storytelling that keeps it pumping. Storytelling is the theme that runs through my various career and life roles – editor, writer, actor, journalist, artist. And it’s stories that fuel my passion, regardless of the medium. I’ve built a career on helping others craft their best narratives and messaging and on developing a strong voice and point of view of my own, whether in print, online, on canvas, on stage, or on camera. 

Currently, I help equip account teams at Deloitte to tell better stories about our managed services to clients. I create or project manage the creation of content that helps our sellers sell, and I oversee the online housing of that content so that it’s findable and accessible. 

Choosing to make the leap from journalism to professional services is unusual, I'll grant you. But the skills I honed at one of Texas’ largest regional newspapers – project managing, clear communication, juggling multiple initiatives at once, strategic thinking, and strong leadership – are serving me well in my new role. (And it's the kind of plot twist that makes for a great story.)

Pete has worked on hundreds of technology M&A transactions ranging from $20 million to $36 billion in size, which includes the second largest technology deal ever and some of the largest technology leveraged buyouts.

headline: Manager, Analytics Application Architecture at Deloitte
about: I'm a web analytics specialist with the ability to speak your language. I began my career in web analytics while working for a small SEO firm called 10X Marketing, where I worked with owners of small one- and two-page web sites to incorporate the SiteCatalyst code into their sites. I accepted a position as a Technical Implementation Consultant with Omniture in 2007, where I worked with clients to identify KPIs and gather reporting requirements, from which I created solution documentation and worked closely with the clients’ development teams to deploy the data collection code and validate the data. I remained with Adobe until January of 2012, when I moved into a similar role with Keystone Solutions, where I was eventually assigned to work with an outdoor retailer called Backcountry.com.  After working with Backcountry for three months as a consultant, they offered me a permanent position as Web Analytics Manager, which I accepted. My responsibilities at Backcountry were to administer the digital marketing suite, provide implementation solutions for new requirements, mentor and train analysts in the use of the interface, and create and manage executive- and management-level dashboards and automated reports.

experience.description: Collaborate with internal development teams to architect and deploy Adobe Analytics data collection code into web-based and mobile apps for the purpose of providing usage data to upper management stakeholders.

Managed and administered the Adobe Digital Marketing suite, including SiteCatalyst, Report Builder, and Discover, for the Finance team as primary data consumer, and Marketing, Merchandising, and Product teams as secondary consumers. Also managed the Adobe contractual relationship. Projects included:
•	Gap Analysis. Analyze usage and purposing of props, eVars, events, etc., to ensure compliance with best practices, and recommended modifications. Also proposed new solutions to leverage new Adobe products.
•	Dashboards. Created and managed several executive and management level dashboards in MS Excel for automatic scheduled delivery by email or via the SiteCatalyst interface; created advanced, multi-site Excel reports including dynamic year-to-date graphs with YoY comparison data.
•	Pricing channel tracking. Devised a solution using merchandising eVars to capture pricing channel information (full price, on sale, clearance); also deployed merchandising eVars in the shopping cart to track price variants on products at checkout (full-price, on-sale, clearance).
•	Search variant tracking. Devised a solution to capture search term suggestions in a list var that could be compared with actual search terms chosen to provide insight on internal search tool usage.
•	Tracking of rotating hero banner ad impressions. Devised a solution to capture impression counts using list variables to replace older method of capturing impressions counts using props.
•	Track Bike Configurator usage. Created a solution to track click locations and conversion paths for the AJAX-based bike configurator page on CompetitiveCyclist web site.
•	MotoSport.com acquisition. Led project to deploy Adobe data collection code to the MotoSport.com website; designed solution for ecommerce tracking to roughly match Backcountry solution on different platform.
•	Mobile site. Designed tracking solution for mobile versions of web properties, focusing on exit path reporting.

Managed SiteCatalyst implementation projects from kick-off to completion, which included KPI analysis, creation of solution documents, technical walk-through with development team members, and data validation. Some projects also included deployment via the Ensighten tag management system. Client projects included:
•	Ashley Furniture. Designed solution for deployment of SiteCatalyst data collection code to web properties, wrote solution documentation, provided expertise and guidance to development team.
•	Nike: Gear Up. Collaborated with other implementation specialists to devise solutions for tracking on-line catalog of athletic gear using Adobe SiteCatalyst.
•	Hasbro: Beyblades. Collaborated with other consultants to create tracking solutions for on-line games and shopping pages.

Created tagging solutions based on best practices with the goal of providing actionable data for clients in the Media and Retail verticals. Administered report suites and configured variables. Provided expertise and guidance throughout the deployment process, as well as data validation prior to production roll-out. Some major clients/projects:
•	Washington Post: Jobs page tracking. Created tagging solution to track job page usage by job seekers and employers with multiple paths.
•	Chicago Sun-Times: gap analysis and redeployment. Performed gap analysis to highlight points of implementation not in compliance with best practices, and made recommendations for improvements; documented gaps in implementation; devised solutions for proposed modifications in accordance with best practices.
•	Beachbody: checkout tracking. Devised an enhanced checkout tracking process that included a new conversion event used to track a product replaced with an upgrade during checkout.
•	Comcast: support forum tracking. Designed a solution to track usage of user support forums; wrote custom script to capture forum, topic, and post title.
•	BassMaster: Implementation. Designed tracking solution to capture visitor pathing, video views, and site hierarchy data.
•	US Open: Implementation. Designed solution to track main US Open tennis tournament site and smaller associate sites.

headline: Partner at Deloitte Tax LLP
about:
Ryan J. Stecz is a partner with Deloitte Tax LLP in the M&A Transaction Services practice, based in Chicago. Ryan has more than 23 years of public accounting experience including more than 21 years with Deloitte and more than 19 years as a dedicated M&A specialist. He has experience in advising financial and strategic buyers on due diligence and deal structuring in a range of industries including manufacturing, real estate, and retail. 

Additionally, Ryan has significant experience advising clients in sell side transactions  including the preparation of carve-out financial statements, vendor due diligence reports and models projecting the tax implications of a proposed transaction.  He also has extensive ASC 740 experience and has worked with many of the firm's leading clients on quarterly and year-end tax provision process and the preparation of tax basis balance sheets.  

Ryan has spoken on a variety of M&A sell side related topics including vendor due diligence best practices, tax considerations of carve-out financial statements, and selling S corporations.  He has also written articles focused on the tax implications of preparing carve-out financial statements and the tax consequences of selling an S corporation.  Additionally, he has been a guest lecturer at the University of Notre Dame's Mendoza College of Business.

Ryan received his bachelor’s degree from The University of Notre Dame.  He is a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants. He currently serves as a member of the finance committee for St. Benedict parish, a member of the endowment board for the St. Benedict Preparatory Schools in Chicago, and a member of the Chairman's Advisory Council for The Big Shoulders Fund.

headline: Manager at Deloitte Consulting
about:
Adam is a Manager in Deloitte Consulting’s Actuarial & Insurance Solutions practice with experience serving large, global (re)insurers. He works at the intersection of Finance and Actuarial, leveraging his deep knowledge of Life, Annuity, and Retirement products, including the reinsurance thereof. 

Adam is increasingly focused on analyzing the influence of management actions on profitability; implementing performance management capabilities; delivering large scale, multi-year solutions to transform and modernize actuarial and finance capabilities, adopting new regulations across valuation bases; and advising management teams on the impacts of strategic reinsurance actions, captive entity configuration, and close calendar expedition. 

Concurrently, he supports Deloitte’s Audit practice, opining on the accuracy of reserves (US GAAP LDTI, US Statutory / Tax, BMA EBS), other actuarial balances (DAC / DAC-like), the quality of experience studies, the reasonableness of actuarial assumptions, and the results of Asset Adequacy / Cash Flow Testing. 

Adam joined Deloitte as a Summer Scholar in June 2017 before graduating from Drake University with a 4.0 GPA in pursuit of his BSBA degree in Actuarial Science and Finance with minors in Data Analytics and Mathematics. He has earned the right to use the CFA and CERA designations and is an FSA and MAAA.

publications.title: Picture of Health
publications.description: The systematic collection and storing of patient health information electronically has existed in various forms for several decades. Recent developments in technological and regulatory environments have accelerated the development, availability and effectiveness of electronic health records (EHRs)—also referred to as electronic medical records (EMRs)—for use in a variety of insurance use cases. This article will examine the current state of EHRs in the insurance world and explore in detail one specific case study of EHRs in life insurance underwriting.

publications.title: Recipes for Next Generation Analytics
publications.description: Many new applications of predictive analytics that affect other core operations of insurance companies are being developed. This article provides a refresher on the different data sources available to insurance companies and provides a deeper dive into several innovative applications of predictive analytics for life insurance and annuity manufacturers.

publications.title: Navigating A New Landscape
publications.description:
Everywhere you turn these days, the topic of big data is being discussed. Big data is collected on a daily basis from sources that include purchases, voluntary surveys, social media posts and Internet
search engines. The retail industry has been using collected data to develop analytics and insight to
support strategic initiatives for years. A recent instance in the insurance industry is auto insurers monitoring consumers’ driving habits in return for discounted insurance premiums.

Since the life insurance industry is in the early stages of using big data, there are some potential challenges and benefits for the two core parties involved: consumers and insurers. Insurance companies are using big data and analytics to streamline operating procedures and processes to deliver their products more efficiently. Consumers stand to gain from this efficiency both in the time to issue as well as the cost of the product. These potential benefits come with potential concerns for consumers’ privacy and permission to use sensitive data.

As explored through several examples in this article, we compare and contrast a traditional process for a life insurance company and an enhanced approach using big data and analytics. If implemented with care by a life insurance company, these enhancements may outweigh any potential disadvantages.

headline: Clinical Assistant Professor, Accountancy, Gies College of Business, University of Illinois; Retired Partner, Deloitte
about:
Mike is a Clinical Assistant Professor of Accountancy at the Gies College of Business, University of Illinois, with a teaching focus on Auditing.  Mike is also a retired Deloitte Audit partner, who for nearly 30 years focused on serving clients ranging from early stage technology and life science companies to established multi-national publicly-owned companies.  He previously led the Chicago office Deloitte Growth Enterprise Services (DGES), now Deloitte Private, audit team, which focused on delivering the resources and experience of a global professional services leader to early stage and middle market companies.   Mike provides well-balanced perspective and advice considering risk, technical requirements and practical application to companies based on their stage of development.

Mike has considerable experience addressing complex accounting and auditing matters, including SEC and IFRS reporting, and has led audit teams in delivering services to multiple pre-IPO companies, working with those companies as they go through their IPO process and become public.   Mike has also counseled companies on the development of their financial organization, internal controls, and risk assessment.  Mike has demonstrated the ability to decipher technical regulations and present matters in an understandable manner to Boards of Directors and Audit Committees allowing them to grasp the full context of the material so they can execute their fiduciary responsibility.

Specialties:  Auditing and SEC Financial Reporting.  Mike specializes in serving publicly-owned companies, including early stage life sciences and technology businesses pursuing an IPO.  Mike also has significant experience serving multinational and middle-market manufacturing and distribution companies.

headline: Problem Solver, Solution Designer, and Communicator
about:
Growing.  We all did it as children, but adults often forget what the experience is like.  It's uncomfortable and often frustrating, whereas it is much easier to remain in your comfort zone.  However, by continually expanding my boundaries and creating meaningful experiences throughout my life, I've come to embrace the discomfort of new challenges and appreciate the resulting benefits to my personal and professional development.  

From engaging in extensive international travel experiences, to reinventing my career numerous times over by learning and applying new skills, to becoming a parent of a fantastic child, and to participating in the creative and performing arts through improv theater, musical theater, and open mic musical performances, my journey has led me to becoming a more open-minded, resourceful, confident, and empathetic individual.  

In my professional life as a management consultant, I am continuously engaging with organizations' thorniest issues.  From determining how best to analyze their issues, to assessing the resources they possess and examining the potential for data- and technology-driven solutions, my background has equipped me with the grit, adaptability, and ability to manage ambiguity that is needed to identify root causes to problems, find and implement appropriate solutions, and communicate/influence throughout the process.  

In my personal life, I use many of these same skills to assist those around me with examining themselves and finding their value.  I've helped numerous people to examine their background and experiences, to sift for hidden nuggets of value, and to craft their story (both written and oral) for presentation to undergraduate and graduate university admissions offices as well as potential new employers.  

This pursuit of growth has led to a virtuous circle of personal development enhancing my professional development, and vice versa.  In every challenge, I push myself to think critically, to bring the wealth of my experiences, and to continue learning in order to expand the frontiers of my own knowledge and value.  The result has been cultivating the ability to conquer ever-larger challenges in a growing number of domains.

headline: Tax Partner in Transaction and Integration Services at Deloitte
about:
Michael, a CPA, is a Chicago-based partner in Deloitte Tax’s national Transaction & Integration Services (“TIS”) group.  He leads the Stock Basis and Earnings & Profits (“E&P”) portion of the TIS group and assists with overall group management.  As a member and leader of this service line, Michael has assisted in the development of firm software and methodology, managed over a thousand stock basis and E&P studies, successfully defended these studies through both IRS examinations and due diligence by other accounting firms, and frequently taught the related tax technical concepts at Deloitte national training and outside seminars.  He has also acted as an expert witness with respect to basis and E&P issues.

In addition to basis and E&P studies, Michael works extensively with other consolidated return issues including significant work with intercompany transactions and the unified loss rules, and the computation of public shareholder tax basis at the time of stock-for-stock tax-free reorganizations.  

Prior to focusing on consolidated return, E&P, and stock basis issues, Michael served as a tax advisor to many large corporate clients and high net worth individuals. 
 
Outside of the office, Michael enjoys coaching his children's sports teams, following his children's other activities, and playing horn in church and community bands and orchestras.

about: A proven project manager with over 20 years of experience in managing complex high dollar and high visibility projects across multiple industries to include Information Technology, Construction, Fundraising, and Publishing

experience.description:
Providing consulting services to the Naval Information Forces (NAVIFOR) Command, Control, Communication, Computer, Cyber, and Intelligence (C5I) information environments to ensure alignment with Naval Networking Environment (NNE) policies, standards, and operational directives.

Provide project management and technical support to include coordination with ~30 separate organizations in support of equipping teams with an advanced small-form factor cyber capability to ensure Fleet-wide success with directed survey, secure, and protect missions. 

Develop key strategic communications for Navy leadership at the Senior Executive Service/Flag Officer/General Officer (SES/FOGO) level, providing updates on program execution and system fielding milestones, highlighting potential challenges, and recommending mitigation strategies.
 
Provided project management and technical support to the engineering, development, and migration of Navy networks to a single security architecture intended to advance the NNE vision of a Joint Information Environment (JIE).

Conducted strategic assessments, gap analysis, readiness, and risk evaluations to inform planning efforts and ensure alignment with both Department of Defense (DoD) and Department of the Navy (DoN) policies and authorized enterprise strategies.

Facilitated discussions between clients and company to define deliverables, set project costs, and create project timelines across the company’s multiple eBusiness platforms. Provided direct supervision, training, and mentoring to a team of project coordinators to ensure compliance with company policies and directives.

Collaborated with development teams that designed, implemented, and deployed eBusiness applications; verified that applications were configured in accordance with client requirements. Managed an average of 35 accounts.

Performed eBusiness site audits to analyze how clients were utilizing applications. These reviews generated sales and training opportunities, enabled best practice sharing, and increased customer satisfaction. 

Conducted training sessions with Tier II help desk support to review troubleshooting best practices.

Facilitated monthly show and tell sessions for 35 company sales representatives and account managers to highlight product best practices and showcase client use of eBusiness tools.

Worked with major universities and colleges to create alumni directory publications. Process involved capturing client requirements, managing deliverables and production schedules, as well as resolving issues.

Managed an average of 60 unique directory projects all with different stakeholders and varying timelines for completion (i.e., 10 months).

Conducted weekly status meetings with management and production teams to provide project performance updates, review outstanding deliverables and issues, and identify corrective and preventative actions to maintain cost, schedule, and scope baselines.

Managed over 100 optometrists that participated in the patient referral program for the medical practice.

Coordinated monthly continuing education events attended by over 50 doctors; determined educational topics, speakers, and marketing collateral.

Collaborated with city officials, architects, engineers, and construction professionals to obtain necessary municipal approvals for multi-million-dollar construction projects.

Managed and obtained building construction permits for the City of Chicago’s Millennium Park, total project cost estimated over $400M. This large and complex project spanned multiple phases over 2 years. 

Completed a company high of 200 projects for the 2003 calendar year, 45 more projects than the company’s average and totaling 10% of all projects completed.

Facilitated business seminars with local architects, engineers, and general contractors to educate stakeholders on City of Chicago Department of Buildings policies and practices.

headline: Data Engineer & BI Consultant
about:
I'm a versatile individual with experience in different fields, including collecting, transforming, and organizing data for analysis to help make data-driven decisions. I have an excellent understanding and proficiency with platforms and tools for effective data analysis, including SQL, spreadsheets, Tableau, Alteryx, R programming, Python, and Microsoft PBI. Strong communication, organizational, and analytical skills, with several years of experience in documentation, evaluation, and analysis. 

Initially, a teacher and historian, now getting into the field of Data Analytics. Surprisingly, the skills required are actually quite similar, the historians' methodology resembles the phases of the data analysis processes exceptionally well, and I simply found myself there, wanting to tell the data's story.

As an Educator for several years in an Elementary School, I learned a lot about observation, documentation, and finally, analysis, as they are key to developing activities to help kids grow and develop themselves in the best possible way.

experience.description:
In the past year, my consulting journey has taken me across diverse industries where I've harnessed the power of data visualization and analytics to drive performance and efficiency. Here's a summary of the sectors I've worked on:

Online Brokerage - Leveraged Tableau to enhance team capabilities in data visualization, fostering a self-supporting community of practitioners and revamping dashboards for improved decision-making and analysis.

Automotive - Pioneered the cleansing of sensor data and crafted Tableau dashboards to monitor vehicle data integrity and performance, collaborating with international teams under tight deadlines.

Publishing/Media - Innovated sentiment analysis of digital content using Alteryx, offering a fresh perspective on audience engagement and streamlining media group operations.

Technical Support - Provided multi-industry client support for issues related to Tableau and Alteryx platforms, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

Varied Projects - Delivered custom Tableau dashboards for sectors including insurance, market research, IT support, media analytics, ESG consultancy, and banking, focusing on areas from risk management to supply chain visualization.

Internal Operations - Optimized internal processes by automating data parsing with Alteryx workflows and refining Tableau dashboards for better data accuracy and reporting.

As an independent consultant, I have developed advanced Spreadsheets and Power BI Reports to empower the stakeholders with actionable insights.

Operational Analytics: I've crafted tools to analyze key performance indicators such as average monthly proposals, customer feedback, decline rates, service approval rates, and gathered improvement suggestions to enhance business strategies.

Financial Analytics: My work has also focused on dissecting financial health by examining cash inflows and outflows, fixed and variable expenses, investments, asset management, and calculating returns on investment to guide financial decision-making.

receivedRecommendations.description:
I had the pleasure of working with Margo when she participated in a high school internship program with my organization, Wild Earth Allies. She earned class credit and gained professional experience by spending 10 hours/week in our office during the 2017-2018 schoolyear. Because she was such a valuable member of our small team, we decided to hire her for a summer internship in 2018. 

Margo’s roles and responsibilities were varied and constantly evolving, as is often the case when working with a small team. She worked inter-departmentally to tackle projects in communications, conservation programming, and fundraising. With each project, I was always impressed by her efficiency, creativity, and ability to work independently. She demonstrated maturity beyond her years and perhaps most importantly, was extremely hardworking.  

For example, Margo played a critical role in managing and drafting social media content. She extracted social-media worthy information from field reports from our global conservation teams, drafted content, and prepared video and photo files for online posts. This required a strong technical understanding of our conservation programs and an ability to communicate scientific concepts in an engaging and easy-to-understand format. 

More than anything, I enjoyed interacting with Margo on a personal level. She is both bright and personable and would make a wonderful addition to any professional team.

honorsAndAwards.title: Innovation Award- Bronze Winner 2019
honorsAndAwards.description:
INEOS Styrolution’s strategy has a strong focus on attractive industry segments including new business opportunities. Such opportunities require innovations in all areas, from product development up to customized system solutions and adjacent technologies. Our yearly Awards INA & IDA, for innovative Ideas and successful innovation projects, strongly support the pro-active identification of new opportunities and are meant to boost the global innovation pipeline. Both awards offer a great opportunity to all INEOS Styrolution employees to think outside the box and to deliver novel, exciting solutions generating tangible benefits for INEOS Styrolution and its customers. "With INA we want to document a change in our innovation perspective. Innovation is not restricted to R&D, it is what every INEOS Styrolution team – from purchasing over production to finance and supply chain – should strive for," explains Norbert Niessner, Director Global R&D and Intellectual Property.

Importance of the awards is emphasized by the fact that the final decision is taken by the Management Board: Five IDA Award winners are chosen out of this pool, presented by the Regional Presidents, as well as the INA Award in Gold, Silver and Bronze. The INA prices are handed over by INEOS Styrolution's CEO.

projects.title: Breaking Gender Stereotypes; Recognizing the Power of Women
projects.description: This research paper addresses the importance of women's influence in the effect, change, and education of future generations. While it remains true a minority of women in the non-western world participate in the workplace, it is a testament to their achievements that this minority group acts as a role model and an agent for change in the society. There is a great potential behind women and in their ability to influence, lead, and become an inspiration to young women all over the world. This paper discusses key points on how women can be provided with equal opportunities, the necessary skills needed to successfully reach leadership positions, and finally, the barriers placed on these women's advancement.  This research highlights interviews with one of the top 100 most powerful Arab business  women in 2017. The data for this research is collected through interviews and an online survey, with a sample size of 140 (110 females and 30 males) from 9 different countries around the world. The interviews have identified the factors that enable the aspiring women to lead, and also what prevents them from reaching the leadership positions. Results indicated about 62% of survey participants do not believe women are treated fairly, and 50% of the participants believe there is very little being done about gender equality.

Greetings! I am pleased to see you on my profile page, and I'm eager to share a bit about myself.

I am a detail-oriented, highly analytical, and committed Master's student in Accounting, who brings a distinctive perspective, having my academic journey in Engineering for the past six years. While this seems like a twist, the unique combination has enabled me to master the art of precision, structured thinking, and data-driven decision-making, which I believe are key to succeed in the evolving world of accounting and consulting.

On the academic front, I have a stellar record, ranking at the top of my cohort, owing to my perseverance and unwavering commitment. My engineering background has provided a solid foundation for my deep understanding of complex problem-solving. Pursuing my Master's degree in Accounting has/will further expand my knowledge in financial reporting, auditing, and taxation. Having embraced the rigorous academic training, I am confident in my ability to contribute meaningfully in the accounting profession.

My experience extends beyond the classroom into student consulting organizations. As a previous Consultant at Illinois Business Consulting and Project Manager at FACES Consulting, I developed a deep understanding of strategic planning and business process optimization. Experience at IBC expose me to the ambiguous nature of consulting, and luckily we were able to navigate through with the fantastic leadership team. Learning curve was steep, but this is what attracts me, and wanted to pursue it for my career.

The team working and leadership skills I learned at IBC were honed at FACES as I led a diverse team to craft an all-encompassing go-to-market strategy for a startup venture capital firm. This hands-on experience also taught me the value of consistent client engagement, evident by achieving the highest client satisfaction score among our consulting teams.

I am a seasoned SAP Employee Central Payroll certified professional with over two decades of experience, dedicated to supporting a wide array of clients spanning diverse industries such as the Public Sector, Non-Profit Organizations, Utilities, Aerospace, Banking, Finance, and Service sectors. My expertise lies in configuring payroll systems, encompassing schema and payroll rules, and leading multifaceted enhancement projects, including database migrations, BSI Tax Factory upgrades, and HRSP upgrades.

Throughout my career, I have consistently demonstrated my commitment to staying at the forefront of the SAP HCM technology. I have successfully implemented cutting-edge functionalities, including Online W-2, Tax Locator, PCC, and Overpayment Recovery, to address evolving client needs.

I take pride in being a trusted SAP Subject Matter Expert (SME) for both legal and business requirements. My diverse scope of experience extends to various facets of SAP HCM, encompassing Employee Central Payroll, On-prem payroll, ESS, MSS, PERSONAS, FIORI Apps, PA, Benefits, and OM modules.

Beyond my professional pursuits, I am deeply passionate about continuous learning, mentoring, and coaching. Engaging with others in discussions about SAP HCM-related topics is a source of personal fulfillment, and I relish the opportunity to provide feedback and valuable insights to fellow professionals in the field.

In my spare time, I am actively involved in volunteering efforts, particularly with FIRST, an organization dedicated to inspiring and nurturing the next generation of science and technology leaders and innovators.

Let's connect and explore opportunities to collaborate or exchange insights within the dynamic world of SAP HCM.

headline: Principal at Deloitte Consulting | 30+ years of Management and Technology consulting experience | Focused on delivering high-impact results to clients in the consumer industry space
about:
I am a Deloitte Consulting Principal based in Chicago with 32+ years of Management and Technology consulting experience. I currently serve as the Consumer Industry Sales Excellence Lead for Deloitte in North America in addition to the Lead Consulting Partner for several clients in the Consumer and Wholesale Distribution industry practice. It is my goal to enable clients to successfully plan, manage, and deliver large and complex transformational programs.
 
My teams and projects succeed through my specialized understandings in digital technologies (such as SAP S/4HANA, Manhattan, Salesforce.com, Oracle, and Vistex), across the enterprise business model, within the wholesale distribution, consumer goods, apparel & fashion, industrial equipment, and financial services industries. 

My experiences span the entire program lifecycle, including upfront opportunity management and value creation through delivery (blueprint to global deployment). Over the course of my career, I have developed an extensive background in process reengineering, technology / business integration, ERP implementation, and large program management experience. 

I’ve also had the joy of playing leadership roles as the Consumer Sales Excellence Lead, Consumer Goods SAP Capability Lead, SAP Financials Capability Group Lead for North America and the Wholesale Distribution Center of Excellence Co-Lead. 

Outside of the office, I enjoy spending time with my wife and three adult children. I'm also a big fan of the Big10 (I met my wife while attending the University of Iowa) and am an avid, albeit extremely average, golfer.

experience.description: Chris was previously a Managing Director based in Chicago with 22+ years of Accenture consulting experience, helping clients plan, manage, and deliver large and complex transformational ERP programs. Chris has specialized in SAP enabled, ERP-wide capabilities, within the wholesale distribution, consumer goods, industrial equipment, and financial services industries. His experiences span the entire program lifecycle, from blueprint through global deployment, and Chris has extensive process reengineering, technology / business integration, ERP implementation, and large program management experience. Chris also plays leadership roles as the SAP Financials Capability Group Lead for North America and the Wholesale Distribution Center of Excellence Co-Lead.
